name: co.frontierresearch/frontier
title: Frontier: new research and citation impact
description: New research from top journals, scored, and any paper's or researcher's FWCI, h-index, retractions.

tools.name: search_breakthroughs
tools.description: Search Frontier's evidence-scored index of new research from the top scientific journals. Matches the query against titles, plain-language summaries, authors and topics, optionally within one field, and returns the matching entries ranked by Frontier Score (or newest paper first), each with its summary, score, Frontier URL and DOI. Leave the query empty to browse a field.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'CRISPR', 'obesity drug', 'quantum error correction'.

sort.description: 'score' ranks by Frontier Score; 'newest' by paper publication date.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 20).

tools.name: latest_breakthroughs
tools.description: What Frontier added most recently: the entries listed in the last N days (the index adds a few new papers from the top journals every day), newest first, optionally within one field.

days.description: How far back to look, in days (1 to 60).

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 20).

tools.name: get_breakthrough
tools.description: Everything Frontier holds on one entry: the plain-language summary, why it matters and what to watch, authors and institutions, the full Frontier Score breakdown (each pillar and what drives it, recency and confidence) and the sources behind each figure. Accepts an OpenAlex work id (e.g. W7214802080), an entry slug, or a frontierresearch.co entry URL.

id.description: OpenAlex work id, entry slug, or Frontier entry URL.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: The research fields Frontier covers, with how many entries each holds and its median Frontier Score.

tools.name: explain_frontier_score
tools.description: The Frontier Score method: its three pillars and what each measures, recency, the integrity rule, tiers and confidence.

tools.name: check_paper
tools.description: Reads one paper's citation impact from OpenAlex and the open citation sources Frontier uses: citations, field-weighted citation impact (FWCI: its citations against papers of the same field, year and type, where 1.0 is the world average), its citation percentile in its field, whether it is in its field's top 10% or top 1%, and whether it is retracted or carries a correction or an expression of concern. Works for any paper, not only those in Frontier's index. Accepts a DOI (or a doi.org link), an OpenAlex work id, a PubMed id (pmid:123), or a title.

paper.description: A DOI, doi.org link, OpenAlex work id (W123...), pmid:<id>, or the paper's title.

tools.name: check_researcher
tools.description: Reads a researcher's whole publication record from OpenAlex (and their public ORCID record): how many papers, total citations, mean and median field-weighted citation impact (FWCI, where 1.0 is the world average), h-index, papers in their field's top 10% and top 1%, any retracted paper, and their highest-impact papers. Give an ORCID iD or an OpenAlex author id; a name returns the matching profiles to choose from.

researcher.description: An ORCID iD (0000-0002-1825-0097), an OpenAlex author id (A5023888391), or a name.
